tests.name: accept_valid_string_json
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly returns true for a JSON document containing standard string values.

tests.name: accept_invalid_string_escape
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept returns false when encountering an invalid string escape sequence.

tests.name: accept_control_character_in_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects unescaped control characters inside a JSON string.

tests.name: accept_malformed_utf8_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects invalid UTF-8 byte sequences inside a string.

tests.name: accept_surrogate_pair_edge_cases
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly handles surrogate pairs and detects dangling high surrogates.

tests.name: accept_with_comments_enabled
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept accepts strings and comments when ignore_comments is true.

tests.name: accept_with_trailing_commas
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept behavior matches trailing comma allowance options.

tests.name: accept_stream_input
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept works correctly when reading from a std::istream source.

tests.name: accept_iterator_range_input
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept can process inputs passed via iterator ranges (begin, end).

tests.name: accept_empty_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects an empty input string.

tests.name: accept_only_whitespace
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly handles inputs consisting only of whitespace characters.

tests.name: accept_deeply_nested_strings
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly processes strings nested inside many levels of arrays and objects.

tests.name: accept_escaped_quotes_and_slashes
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly parses all standard JSON escape sequences in strings.

tests.name: accept_unicode_escape_valid
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept accepts valid 4-digit hexadecimal unicode escape sequences.

tests.name: accept_unicode_escape_malformed
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept rejects incomplete or malformed unicode escape sequences.

tests.name: accept_unclosed_string
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept returns false for a string literal that lacks a closing quotation mark.

tests.name: accept_key_and_string_value_validation
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept checks both object keys and string values for syntax correctness.

tests.name: accept_large_string_literal
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly handles a large string containing a bulk run of ordinary characters.

tests.name: accept_non_string_primitives
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept successfully processes non-string primitives such as numbers, booleans, and null.

tests.name: accept_mixed_array_types
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept correctly processes complex mixed-type JSON documents containing strings, numbers, objects, and arrays.

tests.name: test_accept_multibyte_utf8
tests.intent: Exercise multi-byte UTF-8 character scanning paths (such as two-byte, three-byte, and four-byte UTF-8 sequences via next_byte_in_range) through json::accept.

tests.name: test_accept_invalid_utf8_continuation
tests.intent: Exercise range verification errors inside multi-byte UTF-8 sequences (next_byte_in_range failure) using json::accept with invalid trailing bytes.

tests.name: test_parse_discard_number_values_branch
tests.intent: Exercise discard_values branch during number scanning in parser / lexer by calling parse with an input adapter configuration that triggers it.

tests.name: test_accept_with_true_keep_strings_instantiation
tests.intent: Directly instantiate a parser/lexer combination or trigger code paths where keep_strings is std::true_type via standard parsing methods.

tests.name: test_accept_unsupported_utf8_ranges
tests.intent: Exercise extreme UTF-8 lead bytes (like 0xF4 with out-of-range continuation bytes) via json::accept to hit remaining next_byte_in_range limits.

tests.name: test_accept_multibyte_utf8_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise multi-byte UTF-8 character scanning paths (such as two-byte, three-byte, and four-byte UTF-8 sequences via next_byte_in_range) through json::accept.

tests.name: test_accept_invalid_utf8_continuation_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise range verification errors inside multi-byte UTF-8 sequences (next_byte_in_range failure) using json::accept with invalid trailing bytes.

tests.name: test_parse_discard_number_values_branch_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise discard_values branch during number scanning in parser / lexer by calling parse with an input adapter configuration that triggers it.

tests.name: test_accept_with_true_keep_strings_instantiation_fixed
tests.intent: Directly instantiate a parser/lexer combination or trigger code paths where keep_strings is std::true_type via standard parsing methods.

tests.name: test_accept_unsupported_utf8_ranges_fixed
tests.intent: Exercise extreme UTF-8 lead bytes (like 0xF4 with out-of-range continuation bytes) via json::accept to hit remaining next_byte_in_range limits.
